plugin.name: IMPGoals
plugin.author: Eric
plugin.purpose: Set Instinct / Mastery / Potential goals and see what it costs to reach them

muclient.script:
dofile (GetInfo (60) .. "aardwolf_colors.lua") local gHaveCapture = pcall (require, "wrapped_captures") local gHaveWin = pcall (require, "themed_miniwindows")
local VERSION = "1.5" local DIR = GetPluginInfo (GetPluginID (), 20) local DATA_FILE = DIR .. "IMPGoals_data.lua"
-- set by the embedded cost tables at the very end of this script local core_ok, core_err = false, "cost tables not loaded"
-- Eric's standard colours: hex for the window, @-codes for echoes. local CLR_TAG = "#875FFF" -- x099 local CLR_NAME = "#00D7FF" -- x045 local CLR_MSG = "#FFFFFF" -- white local CLR_HI = "#00FF87" -- x048
-- display order everywhere (window, echo, channel): Eric asked for I-M-P (v1.2) local KIND_ORDER = { "instinct", "mastery", "potential" } local KIND_TITLE = { potential = "Potential", instinct = "Instinct", mastery = "Mastery" } -- currencies each kind costs, in print order local KIND_CUR = { potential = { "qp" }, instinct = { "trains", "gold" }, mastery = { "qp", "gold" } } local CUR_ORDER = { "qp", "trains", "gold" } local CUR_LABEL = { qp = "QP", trains = "trains", gold = "gold" } local CHAN_MAX = 300 -- plain characters before a channel line falls back to counts
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- echoes function cnote (s) AnsiNote (stylesToANSI (ColoursToStyles (s))) end
local function tag (msg) cnote ("@x099[@x045IMPGoals@x099]@W " .. msg) end
local function commas (n) if IMPCosts and IMPCosts.commas then return IMPCosts.commas (n) end return tostring (n) end
local function core_ready () if core_ok and IMPCosts and IMPCosts.cost and IMPCosts.max then return true end tag ("@x099The built-in cost tables failed to load@W - IMPGoals cannot work out costs.") if core_err then cnote (" " .. tostring (core_err)) end return false end
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- saved data -- gDB[charname] = { when = os.time(), levels = { {kind,name,level}, ... }, -- goals = { ["kind|lowername"] = n } } local gDB = {}
local function char_name () local ok, n = pcall (gmcp, "char.base.name") if ok and type (n) == "string" and n ~= "" then return n end return "default" end
local function me () local n = char_name () gDB [n] = gDB [n] or { when = 0, levels = {}, goals = {} } local d = gDB [n] d.levels = d.levels or {} d.goals = d.goals or {} return d end
local function goal_key (kind, name) return kind .. "|" .. string.lower (name) end
local function load_db () local f = loadfile (DATA_FILE) if not f then return end setfenv (f, {}) local ok, t = pcall (f) if ok and type (t) == "table" then gDB = t end end
local function save_db () local out = { "-- IMPGoals saved goals + last levels read. Written by the plugin.", "return {" } for who, d in pairs (gDB) do out [#out + 1] = string.format (" [%q] = {", who) out [#out + 1] = string.format (" when = %d,", tonumber (d.when) or 0) out [#out + 1] = " levels = {" for _, r in ipairs (d.levels or {}) do out [#out + 1] = string.format (" { kind = %q, name = %q, level = %d },", r.kind, r.name, r.level) end out [#out + 1] = " }," out [#out + 1] = " goals = {" for k, v in pairs (d.goals or {}) do out [#out + 1] = string.format (" [%q] = %d,", k, v) end out [#out + 1] = " }," out [#out + 1] = " }," end out [#out + 1] = "}" local tmp = DATA_FILE .. ".tmp" local fh = io.open (tmp, "wb") if not fh then tag ("@x099Could not save goals@W to " .. DATA_FILE) return end fh:write (table.concat (out, "\r\n"), "\r\n") fh:close () os.remove (DATA_FILE) local ok = os.rename (tmp, DATA_FILE) if not ok then tag ("@x099Could not save goals@W (rename failed).") end end
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- parsing local function trim (s) return (s:gsub ("^%s+", ""):gsub ("%s+$", "")) end local function num (s) return tonumber ((tostring (s or ""):gsub (",", ""))) end
-- texts = { instinct = "...", mastery = "...", potential = "..." } function IMPGoals_Parse (texts) local rows = {}
for line in (texts.potential or ""):gmatch ("[^\r\n]+") do local p = line:match ("You have ([%d,]+) points? of potential") if p then rows [#rows + 1] = { kind = "potential", name = "Potential", level = num (p) } break end end
for line in (texts.instinct or ""):gmatch ("[^\r\n]+") do local body = line:gsub ("^%s*Level%s+%d+%s*:", "") local name, sn, learned, inst = body:match ("^%s*(%a.-)%s+(%d+)%s+(%d+)%%%s+(%d+)%s") if name and not line:find ("(Uses ", 1, true) then rows [#rows + 1] = { kind = "instinct", name = trim (name), level = tonumber (inst) } end end
for line in (texts.mastery or ""):gmatch ("[^\r\n]+") do local name, lvl = line:match ("^%s*(%a[%a ]-)%s+(%d+)%s+%S+%s+%S+%s*$") if name then rows [#rows + 1] = { kind = "mastery", name = trim (name), level = tonumber (lvl) } end end
local have = {} for _, r in ipairs (rows) do have [r.kind] = true end local missing = {} for _, k in ipairs (KIND_ORDER) do if not have [k] then missing [#missing + 1] = KIND_TITLE [k] end end return rows, missing end
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- cost maths -- Every goal above its current level, each costed from the current level. -- Banked QP / gold / trains are deliberately NOT subtracted. function IMPGoals_Compute (d) local res = { items = {}, total = { qp = 0, trains = 0, gold = 0 }, count = {}, sub = {} } for _, r in ipairs (d.levels or {}) do local g = d.goals [goal_key (r.kind, r.name)] if g then local top = IMPCosts.max (r.kind) or g if g > top then g = top end if g > r.level then local c = IMPCosts.cost (r.kind, r.level, g) or {} res.items [#res.items + 1] = { row = r, goal = g, cost = c } res.count [r.kind] = (res.count [r.kind] or 0) + 1 res.sub [r.kind] = res.sub [r.kind] or {} for cur, v in pairs (c) do res.total [cur] = (res.total [cur] or 0) + v res.sub [r.kind] [cur] = (res.sub [r.kind] [cur] or 0) + v end end end end return res end
-- "12,345 QP, 1,000,000 gold" with colour codes local function cost_text (kind, c) local parts = {} for _, cur in ipairs (KIND_CUR [kind]) do parts [#parts + 1] = "@x048" .. commas (c [cur] or 0) .. " @W" .. CUR_LABEL [cur] end return table.concat (parts, "@W, ") end
local function total_text (t) local parts = {} for _, cur in ipairs (CUR_ORDER) do if (t [cur] or 0) > 0 then parts [#parts + 1] = "@x048" .. commas (t [cur]) .. " @W" .. CUR_LABEL [cur] end end return table.concat (parts, "@W, ") end
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- silent reads local CMDS = { "instinct", "mastery", "potential" } local gBusy = false
local function styles_text (lines) local out = {} for _, st in ipairs (lines or {}) do local t = {} for _, s in ipairs (st) do t [#t + 1] = s.text or "" end out [#out + 1] = table.concat (t) end return table.concat (out, "\n") end
-- v1.5: a goal you have reached is deleted by itself. Only goals whose row -- is in the levels list are checked (a missing row is left alone). local function prune_reached (d) local gone = {} for _, r in ipairs (d.levels or {}) do local k = goal_key (r.kind, r.name) local g = d.goals [k] if g and r.level >= g then d.goals [k] = nil gone [#gone + 1] = (r.kind == "potential" and "Potential" or r.name) .. " " .. g end end if #gone > 0 then tag ("@x048Goal reached@W, removed: @x045" .. table.concat (gone, "@W, @x045") .. "@W") end return #gone > 0 end
-- Runs the three commands one after another with all output hidden, stores -- the levels, then calls on_done(true) or on_done(false, reason). local function read_all (on_done) if not gHaveCapture then on_done (false, "wrapped_captures.lua did not load - cannot read silently.") return end if gBusy then tag ("Still reading your levels - try again in a moment.") return end gBusy = true local texts = {} local step step = function (i) local cmd = CMDS [i] if not cmd then gBusy = false local rows, missing = IMPGoals_Parse (texts) if #rows == 0 then on_done (false, "Nothing recognised in the instinct / mastery / potential output.") return end local d = me () d.levels = rows d.when = os.time () prune_reached (d) save_db () if #missing > 0 then tag ("@x099Could not read@W " .. table.concat (missing, ", ") .. "@W - those rows are missing.") end on_done (true) return end local ok, err = pcall (Capture.untagged_output, cmd, true, -- don't echo the command true, -- hide the output true, -- no prompt afterwards function (lines) texts [cmd] = styles_text (lines) step (i + 1) end, false, function () gBusy = false on_done (false, "Timed out reading '" .. cmd .. "'.") end, 10) if not ok then gBusy = false on_done (false, "Capture failed: " .. tostring (err)) end end step (1) end
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- window local WIN_ID = "IMPGoals_win" local WIN_FONT = "Consolas" local WIN_FONT_SIZE = 12 local WIN_MAX_W = 1000 local WIN_MAX_H = 600 local gWin = nil
local gColCache = {} local function col (hex) if not gColCache [hex] then gColCache [hex] = ColourNameToRGB (hex) end return gColCache [hex] end
-- styles + hyperlinks for one line; link positions count visible text only local function win_line (segs) local styles, links, pos = {}, {}, 1 for _, s in ipairs (segs) do if s.text ~= "" then styles [#styles + 1] = { text = s.text, textcolour = col (s.colour or CLR_MSG) } if s.code then links [#links + 1] = { start = pos, stop = pos + #s.text - 1, text = s.code, label = s.tip } end pos = pos + #s.text end end return styles, links end
local function cost_segs (kind, c) local segs = {} for i, cur in ipairs (KIND_CUR [kind]) do if i > 1 then segs [#segs + 1] = { text = ", " } end segs [#segs + 1] = { text = commas (c [cur] or 0), colour = CLR_HI } segs [#segs + 1] = { text = " " .. CUR_LABEL [cur] } end return segs end
-- v1.4 slot window: 3 Instinct slots, 3 Mastery slots, 1 Potential local SLOTS = 3 local SLOT_NAME_W = 18
local function find_row (d, kind, name) local want = string.lower (name) for _, r in ipairs (d.levels or {}) do if r.kind == kind and string.lower (r.name) == want then return r end end return nil end
-- goal keys of one kind, in a steady (alphabetical) order local function slot_keys (d, kind) local out = {} for k in pairs (d.goals or {}) do if k:sub (1, #kind + 1) == kind .. "|" then out [#out + 1] = k end end table.sort (out) return out end
function IMPGoals_WinOpen (keep_scroll) if not gHaveWin or type (ThemedTextWindow) ~= "function" then tag ("@x099themed_miniwindows did not load@W - no window possible. Use @x048impgoals@W instead.") return false end if gWin and not (ThemedWindowClass and ThemedWindowClass.window_map and ThemedWindowClass.window_map [WIN_ID]) then gWin = nil pcall (WindowDelete, WIN_ID) end if not gWin then local ok, w = pcall (ThemedTextWindow, WIN_ID, 200, 100, -- default left, top (it remembers where you drag it) 640, 400, -- default size (fit_contents resizes it) "IMPGoals", "center", true, -- title-bar close button false, -- resizeable true, -- text scrolls (mouse wheel and scrollbar) false, false, false, true, -- autowrap WIN_FONT, WIN_FONT_SIZE, WIN_FONT, WIN_FONT_SIZE, 300, nil, true, -- draw before showing false, nil, "Close") if not ok or not w then tag ("@x099Window failed@W: " .. tostring (w)) return false end gWin = w if gWin.textrect and gWin.textrect.font_bold then gWin.textrect.font = gWin.textrect.font_bold end local prior = gWin.do_on_delete gWin.do_on_delete = function (self) if prior then prior (self) end gWin = nil end gWin.bring_to_front = function (self) pcall (WindowSetZOrder, WIN_ID, 99999) end end
local d = me () if prune_reached (d) then save_db () end local keep = nil if keep_scroll and gWin.textrect then keep = tonumber (gWin.textrect.display_start_line) end gWin:clear (false)
local function add (segs) local st, lk = win_line (segs) -- a blank line must still be one style: TextRect (via ToMultilineStyles) -- throws on an empty styles table (v1.0 crashed on its spacer lines) if #st == 0 then st = { { text = " ", textcolour = col (CLR_MSG) } } end gWin:add_text (st, false, lk) end
add { { text = "[", colour = CLR_TAG, code = "IMPGoals_Refresh()", tip = "Re-read your levels" }, { text = "Refresh", colour = CLR_HI, code = "IMPGoals_Refresh()", tip = "Re-read your levels" }, { text = "]", colour = CLR_TAG, code = "IMPGoals_Refresh()", tip = "Re-read your levels" }, { text = " " }, { text = "[", colour = CLR_TAG, code = "IMPGoals_Echo()", tip = "Echo the costs to the output window" }, { text = "Echo totals", colour = CLR_HI, code = "IMPGoals_Echo()", tip = "Echo the costs to the output window" }, { text = "]", colour = CLR_TAG, code = "IMPGoals_Echo()", tip = "Echo the costs to the output window" }, { text = " levels read " .. ((d.when or 0) > 0 and os.date ("%H:%M", d.when) or "never"), colour = CLR_NAME }, } add { { text = "Click a name to pick what to goal for, the number box to set the goal." } }
local res = IMPGoals_Compute (d) local by_key = {} for _, it in ipairs (res.items) do by_key [goal_key (it.row.kind, it.row.name)] = it end
-- one link segment wrapped in purple [ ] local function boxed (segs, text, colour, code, tip) segs [#segs + 1] = { text = "[", colour = CLR_TAG, code = code, tip = tip } segs [#segs + 1] = { text = text, colour = colour, code = code, tip = tip } segs [#segs + 1] = { text = "]", colour = CLR_TAG, code = code, tip = tip } end
local function pad (s, w) if #s > w then return s:sub (1, w) end return s .. string.rep (" ", w - #s) end
local WNAME = SLOT_NAME_W for _, kind in ipairs (KIND_ORDER) do add { { text = "" } } add { { text = KIND_TITLE [kind], colour = CLR_TAG }, { text = string.rep (" ", WNAME + 7 - #KIND_TITLE [kind]) .. " Now Goal Cost to goal", colour = CLR_NAME }, } local top = IMPCosts.max (kind) or 0
if kind == "potential" then local r = find_row (d, kind, "Potential") local segs = { { text = " " }, { text = pad ("Potential", WNAME + 2) } } if not r then segs [#segs + 1] = { text = " ? not read yet - click Refresh", colour = CLR_NAME } else local k = goal_key (kind, r.name) local goal = d.goals [k] segs [#segs + 1] = { text = string.format ("%4d", r.level), colour = CLR_NAME } segs [#segs + 1] = { text = " " } if r.level >= top then segs [#segs + 1] = { text = "[ max]", colour = CLR_TAG } else boxed (segs, goal and string.format ("%5d", goal) or " set", goal and CLR_HI or CLR_MSG, string.format ("IMPGoals_Edit(%q)", k), string.format ("Set a Potential goal (max %d)", top)) if goal then segs [#segs + 1] = { text = " " } boxed (segs, "x", CLR_MSG, string.format ("IMPGoals_Clear(%q)", k), "Delete this goal") end end segs [#segs + 1] = { text = " " } local it = by_key [k] if it then for _, s in ipairs (cost_segs (kind, it.cost)) do segs [#segs + 1] = s end elseif goal then segs [#segs + 1] = { text = "reached", colour = CLR_HI } end end add (segs)
else local slots = slot_keys (d, kind) local n = math.max (SLOTS, #slots) for i = 1, n do local k = slots [i] local segs = { { text = string.format (" %d ", i), colour = CLR_NAME } } if not k then local what = kind == "instinct" and "+ pick a skill" or "+ pick a type" boxed (segs, pad (what, WNAME), CLR_MSG, string.format ("IMPGoals_Pick(%q,%q)", kind, ""), "Choose a " .. (kind == "instinct" and "skill" or "mastery type") .. " to goal for") else local name = k:match ("^[^|]+|(.*)$") or k local r = find_row (d, kind, name) local goal = d.goals [k] local shown = r and r.name or name boxed (segs, pad (shown, WNAME), CLR_MSG, string.format ("IMPGoals_Pick(%q,%q)", kind, k), "Swap this slot to a different " .. (kind == "instinct" and "skill" or "type")) segs [#segs + 1] = { text = r and string.format ("%4d", r.level) or " ?", colour = CLR_NAME } segs [#segs + 1] = { text = " " } boxed (segs, string.format ("%5d", goal), CLR_HI, string.format ("IMPGoals_Edit(%q)", k), string.format ("Change the goal for %s (max %d)", shown, top)) segs [#segs + 1] = { text = " " } boxed (segs, "x", CLR_MSG, string.format ("IMPGoals_Clear(%q)", k), "Delete this goal") segs [#segs + 1] = { text = " " } local it = by_key [k] if it then for _, s in ipairs (cost_segs (kind, it.cost)) do segs [#segs + 1] = s end elseif not r then segs [#segs + 1] = { text = "not in your list", colour = CLR_NAME } else segs [#segs + 1] = { text = "reached", colour = CLR_HI } end end add (segs) end end end
add { { text = "" } } if #res.items == 0 then add { { text = "No goals set yet.", colour = CLR_NAME } } else for _, kind in ipairs (KIND_ORDER) do if res.sub [kind] then local segs = { { text = KIND_TITLE [kind] .. ": ", colour = CLR_TAG } } for _, sg in ipairs (cost_segs (kind, res.sub [kind])) do segs [#segs + 1] = sg end add (segs) end end local segs = { { text = "Total: ", colour = CLR_NAME } } local n = 0 for _, cur in ipairs (CUR_ORDER) do if (res.total [cur] or 0) > 0 then if n > 0 then segs [#segs + 1] = { text = ", " } end segs [#segs + 1] = { text = commas (res.total [cur]), colour = CLR_HI } segs [#segs + 1] = { text = " " .. CUR_LABEL [cur] } n = n + 1 end end add (segs) add { { text = "(banked QP / gold / trains not taken off)" } } end
pcall (function () gWin:fit_contents (WIN_MAX_W, WIN_MAX_H) end) pcall (function () gWin:set_scroll (keep or 1) end) gWin:draw () gWin:show () pcall (WindowSetZOrder, WIN_ID, 99999) pcall (Repaint) return true end
-- link click -> open the input box from a timer, outside the click callback function IMPGoals_Edit (k) DoAfterSpecial (0.1, "IMPGoals_EditNow(" .. string.format ("%q", tostring (k)) .. ")", sendto.script) end
-- Ask for a goal number. Returns a number, "clear" (blank), or nil (cancelled -- or not a whole number). local function ask_goal (row, cur) local top = IMPCosts.max (row.kind) or 0 local label = row.kind == "potential" and "Potential" or (row.name .. " " .. string.lower (KIND_TITLE [row.kind])) local s = utils.inputbox (string.format ("Goal for %s - now %d, max %d. Leave blank to clear.", label, row.level, top), "IMPGoals", cur and tostring (cur) or "") if s == nil then return nil end -- cancelled s = trim (s):gsub (",", "") if s == "" then return "clear" end local n = tonumber (s) if not n or n < 0 or n ~= math.floor (n) then tag ("@x099'" .. s .. "'@W is not a whole number - goal not changed.") return nil end if n > top then tag (label .. " only goes to @x048" .. top .. "@W - goal set to " .. top .. ".") n = top end if n <= row.level then tag (label .. " is already @x048" .. row.level .. "@W - pick a goal above that.") return nil end return n end
function IMPGoals_EditNow (k) local d = me () local row for _, r in ipairs (d.levels) do if goal_key (r.kind, r.name) == k then row = r break end end if not row then return end local n = ask_goal (row, d.goals [k]) if n == nil then return end if n == "clear" then d.goals [k] = nil else d.goals [k] = n end save_db () if gWin then IMPGoals_WinOpen (true) end end
-- [name] box: pick (or swap to) a skill / mastery type, then ask its goal. -- old_k is the slot's current goal key, "" for an empty slot. function IMPGoals_Pick (kind, old_k) DoAfterSpecial (0.1, string.format ("IMPGoals_PickNow(%q,%q)", tostring (kind), tostring (old_k or "")), sendto.script) end
function IMPGoals_PickNow (kind, old_k) local d = me () local top = IMPCosts.max (kind) or 0 local taken = {} for _, k in ipairs (slot_keys (d, kind)) do if k ~= old_k then taken [k] = true end end if old_k == "" and #slot_keys (d, kind) >= SLOTS then tag ("All " .. SLOTS .. " " .. KIND_TITLE [kind] .. " slots are full - delete one with its @x099[@Wx@x099]@W first.") return end local choices, rows = {}, {} for _, r in ipairs (d.levels) do local k = goal_key (r.kind, r.name) if r.kind == kind and r.level < top and not taken [k] then choices [k] = string.format ("%s (now %d)", r.name, r.level) rows [k] = r end end if next (choices) == nil then tag ("Nothing left to pick for " .. KIND_TITLE [kind] .. " - click @x048Refresh@W if your levels are stale.") return end local what = kind == "instinct" and "skill" or "mastery type" local k = utils.listbox ("Pick the " .. what .. " to goal for:", "IMPGoals - " .. KIND_TITLE [kind], choices, old_k ~= "" and choices [old_k] and old_k or nil) if not k or not rows [k] then return end -- cancelled local n = ask_goal (rows [k], k == old_k and d.goals [old_k] or nil) if n == nil or n == "clear" then return end -- nothing chosen: slot left as it was if old_k ~= "" then d.goals [old_k] = nil end d.goals [k] = n save_db () if gWin then IMPGoals_WinOpen (true) end end
-- x next to a slot: empty it function IMPGoals_Clear (k) DoAfterSpecial (0.1, string.format ("IMPGoals_ClearNow(%q)", tostring (k)), sendto.script) end
function IMPGoals_ClearNow (k) local d = me () d.goals [tostring (k)] = nil save_db () if gWin then IMPGoals_WinOpen (true) end end
function IMPGoals_Refresh () read_all (function (ok, err) if not ok then tag ("@x099" .. err) end if gWin then IMPGoals_WinOpen (true) end end) end
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- reports local function echo_totals () local d = me () if #d.levels == 0 then tag ("No levels read yet - type @x048impgoals config@W first.") return end local res = IMPGoals_Compute (d) if #res.items == 0 then tag ("No goals left to reach. Set some with @x048impgoals config@W.") return end tag ("Cost to reach your goals @W(from your current levels; banked QP / gold / trains not taken off):") for _, kind in ipairs (KIND_ORDER) do if res.sub [kind] then if kind == "potential" then for _, it in ipairs (res.items) do if it.row.kind == kind then cnote (string.format (" @x099Potential@W @x045%d@W -> @x048%d@W : %s", it.row.level, it.goal, cost_text (kind, it.cost))) end end else cnote (" @x099" .. KIND_TITLE [kind] .. "@W: " .. cost_text (kind, res.sub [kind])) for _, it in ipairs (res.items) do if it.row.kind == kind then cnote (string.format (" @W%s @x045%d@W -> @x048%d@W : %s", it.row.name, it.row.level, it.goal, cost_text (kind, it.cost))) end end end end end cnote (" @x045Total@W: " .. total_text (res.total)) end
function IMPGoals_Echo () echo_totals () end
-- One line for a channel, in Instinct, Mastery, Potential order: each -- section's goals and its own cost, then the total. If listing every goal -- runs past CHAN_MAX plain characters, sections show a count instead. -- [IMPGoals] Instinct (Dodge 139>140): 3,675 trains, 15,900,000 gold | -- Mastery (...): ... | Potential (275>300): 267,500 QP | Total: ... local function channel_line () local d = me () local res = IMPGoals_Compute (d) if #res.items == 0 then return nil end
local function build (detailed) local parts = {} for _, kind in ipairs (KIND_ORDER) do if res.sub [kind] then local what = {} for _, it in ipairs (res.items) do if it.row.kind == kind then local nm = kind == "potential" and "" or (it.row.name .. " ") what [#what + 1] = "@W" .. nm .. "@x045" .. it.row.level .. "@W>@x048" .. it.goal end end local inside if detailed or kind == "potential" then inside = table.concat (what, "@W, ") else local n = res.count [kind] inside = "@x048" .. n .. "@W " .. (kind == "instinct" and "skill" or "type") .. (n > 1 and "s" or "") end parts [#parts + 1] = "@x045" .. KIND_TITLE [kind] .. " @W(" .. inside .. "@W): " .. cost_text (kind, res.sub [kind]) end end return "@x099[@x045IMPGoals@x099]@W " .. table.concat (parts, "@W | ") .. "@W | @x045Total@W: " .. total_text (res.total) .. "@W" end
local line = build (true) if #IMPCosts.plain (line) > CHAN_MAX then line = build (false) end return line end
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------- aliases function impgoals_config (name, line, wc) if not core_ready () then return end tag ("Reading your instinct, mastery and potential...") read_all (function (ok, err) if not ok then tag ("@x099" .. err) if #me ().levels == 0 then return end tag ("Showing the levels read last time.") end IMPGoals_WinOpen (false) end) end
function impgoals_window (name, line, wc) if not core_ready () then return end if #me ().levels == 0 then tag ("No levels read yet - type @x048impgoals config@W first.") return end IMPGoals_WinOpen (false) end
function impgoals_totals (name, line, wc) if not core_ready () then return end read_all (function (ok, err) if not ok then tag ("@x099" .. err .. "@W - using the levels read last time.") end echo_totals () if gWin then IMPGoals_WinOpen (true) end end) end
function impgoals_channel (name, line, wc) if not core_ready () then return end local chan = string.lower (wc [1]) read_all (function (ok, err) if not ok then tag ("@x099" .. err .. "@W - using the levels read last time.") end if #me ().levels == 0 then tag ("No levels read yet - type @x048impgoals config@W first.") return end local msg = channel_line () if not msg then tag ("No goals left to reach - nothing sent.") return end Execute (chan .. " " .. msg) if gWin then IMPGoals_WinOpen (true) end end) end
function impgoals_clear (name, line, wc) local d = me () local n = 0 for _ in pairs (d.goals) do n = n + 1 end d.goals = {} save_db () tag ("Cleared @x048" .. n .. "@W goal" .. (n == 1 and "" or "s") .. ".") if gWin and core_ok then IMPGoals_WinOpen (true) end end
-- A plugin cannot ReloadPlugin itself from its own script space (the timer -- dies with it), so bounce through the world's script space - SnD's pattern. function impgoals_reload (name, line, wc) tag ("Reloading...") if gWin then pcall (function () gWin:delete () end) end gWin = nil pcall (WindowDelete, WIN_ID) Execute (GetAlphaOption ("script_prefix") .. 'DoAfterSpecial(1, "ReloadPlugin(\'' .. GetPluginID () .. '\')", sendto.script)') end

-- Mastery level -> % more damage (from the in-game table). Anything between -- the listed points is a straight-line interpolation; 0 mastery = 0%. local PCT_POINTS = { { 0, 0 }, { 16, 5 }, { 37, 10 }, { 65, 15 }, { 104, 20 }, { 163, 25 }, { 260, 30 }, { 455, 35 }, { 1039, 40 }, }
function M.mastery_pct(level) local last = PCT_POINTS[#PCT_POINTS] if level >= last[1] then return last[2] end for i = 2, #PCT_POINTS do local lo, hi = PCT_POINTS[i - 1], PCT_POINTS[i] if level <= hi[1] then return lo[2] + (hi[2] - lo[2]) * (level - lo[1]) / (hi[1] - lo[1]) end end return last[2] end
-- 12345678 -> "12,345,678" function M.commas(n) local s = tostring(math.floor(n + 0.5)) local out = s while true do local r, k = out:gsub("^(-?%d+)(%d%d%d)", "%1,%2") out = r if k == 0 then break end end return out end
-- 12.5 -> "12.5", 30 -> "30", 7.04 -> "7" local function pct_text(p) local s = string.format("%.1f", p) s = s:gsub("%.0$", "") return s .. "%" end
function M.kind_ok(kind) return KINDS[string.lower(kind or "")] ~= nil end
-- Returns the coloured result line, or nil + a plain error message. -- kind "mastery" | "potential" | "instinct" (any case) -- a, b levels. b == nil means "0 to a". -- Colours: @x099 yellow, @x045 cyan, @W white, @x048 green. function M.build(kind, a, b) local k = KINDS[string.lower(kind or "")] if not k then return nil, "Unknown type '" .. tostring(kind) .. ")." end if a == b then return nil, "Those levels are the same - nothing to cost." end

Added for IMPGoals. function M.cost(kind, a, b) local k = KINDS[string.lower(kind or "")] a, b = tonumber(a), tonumber(b) if not k or not a or not b then return nil end a = math.max(0, math.floor(a)) b = math.min(k.max, math.floor(b)) local out = {} for _, c in ipairs(k.cost) do local cum = k.data[c[1]] if b <= a then out[c[1]] = 0 else out[c[1]] = cum[b] - ((a > 0) and cum[a] or 0) end end return out end
